title: AID Susceptibility Extension with Inline Observation and Isolated Evaluation
summary: Extends the AID cycle's Attend phase to notice susceptibility signals (rising assertion density, solution-space narrowing without user initiation, unmodified adoption of agent framing, confidence markers at artifact-production moments, declining engagement with alternatives) without evaluating them inline. Evaluation happens in an isolated context: a specialist subagent reads the observed signals and produces an advisory, non-blocking Susceptibility Snapshot artifact, dispatched at phase boundaries rather than continuously.
workflow_point: AID cycle Attend phase (inline); phase boundaries (isolated evaluation dispatch)
mechanism: inline susceptibility-signal observation with isolated-subagent Susceptibility Snapshot evaluation

links.note: The Susceptibility Snapshot artifact follows Artifact-Mediated Communication (ADR-031) as a durable, inspectable specialist-subagent output.
Extends the AID cycle (ADR-040) with susceptibility-signal observation during Attend and isolated evaluation via a Susceptibility Snapshot.
The Susceptibility Snapshot's advisory findings are converted into actionable forks by the Grounding Reframe (ADR-059), mitigating the risk that an advisory snapshot is simply ignored.
Assertion-Aware Observation (ADR-062) provides mid-phase susceptibility coverage between this ADR's phase-boundary snapshots.
Retroactively anchored (Cycle 10 backward-propagation note, 2026-04-09) by ADR-064's Harness Layer compound check, added as defense-in-depth for the snapshot's dispatch under Invariant 8.

Retroactively anchored (Cycle 10 backward-propagation note, 2026-04-09) by ADR-065's Skill-Structure Layer, which adds per-phase susceptibility-snapshot dispatch sites at structurally privileged positions in each phase skill.
